aoa-decision.notes: The only currently advertised AoA family; record and correct effects still require owner authority.

aoa-engineering-shape.notes: Deferred candidate family; produces a proposed boundary and never claims owner adoption.

aoa-eval.notes: Deferred candidate family; local application or proposal cannot grant central proof authority.

aoa-verification.notes: Deferred candidate family; manual evidence and owner meaning precede durable automation.

aoa-knowledge-stewardship.notes: Deferred candidate family; creation, publication, and durable memory remain separate owner effects.

aoa-session-harvest.notes: Deferred candidate family; produces session-local candidates only from reviewed evidence.

aoa-session-recovery.notes: Deferred candidate family; diagnosis and repair proposal grant no mutation authority.
